value.rationale: The n-term sum constants c(n;X) are the central quantitative invariant in arXiv:2610.35259. For its canonical rearrangement gauge, the theorem gives exact all-n constants as an attained one-parameter discrete maximum and extremizing block construction, rather than an order estimate. Already for k=2, singleton vectors miss a proven larger finite-block lower bound; this directly motivates precise values under equivalent logarithmic quasi-norms.
